subject.title: feat(tools): introduce group:core for all built-in core tools

question: Should `group:core` become a permanent public tool-policy contract for all available OpenClaw-owned core tools, excluding plugin-owned tools?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and proven, but repository policy sets a high bar for new public configuration vocabulary and requires owner intent rather than an automated product decision.

options.title: Adopt `group:core`
options.body: Approve the descriptor-derived group, documented plugin exclusion, and obligation to include future core factories.

options.title: Keep existing vocabulary
options.body: Decline the new token and document broad access through existing profile, wildcard, and `group:plugins` composition.

recommendation.title: Adopt `group:core`
recommendation.body: Approve the descriptor-derived group, documented plugin exclusion, and obligation to include future core factories.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current tool-policy architecture across the exact central files changed by this PR.
